title: Batch account notifications
description: A notification refactor introduces per-account subjects and changes how sends are scheduled.
commitMessage: Generate personalized subjects while batching monthly email sends.
reviewContext: Only accounts with allowEmail=true may receive email. notifyAccounts must remain pending until all successful sends finish and must reject if any send fails. Parallel sending is allowed; cancellation of sibling sends after a failure is not required. Accounts and addresses have already been validated. No notification retries are performed inside this function.
